source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. The winter-solstice bonfire festival: a huge fire roars up into the dark snowy sky, the whole village dances in a ring around it, sparks fly toward the dragon's mountain. Joyful, rustic and uplifting jig, full of life, with a proud, hopeful melody. Tempo 112 BPM, 6/8 time, key of D major. Instrumentation: two folk fiddles in harmony, wooden flute, hurdy-gurdy style drone, frame drums and hand claps, plucked lute, low strings, small bells. Form: drum and drone pickup; section A lively fiddle jig; section B flute and fiddles trade a soaring phrase; percussion break with claps; section A returns fuller; the last bar leads back to section A. Duration: 90 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
